topics.focus: Change assertive/reported statements from direct to indirect; tense backshift; say/said that; reporting verb in past; no question/command forms.
WH-questions → asked + wh-word + statement order; yes/no → asked if/whether; no question mark; tense and pronoun changes.
Imperatives → ordered/requested/advised + object + to-infinitive; negative commands → not to; Let's → suggested that they should.
Reverse conversion: restore inverted commas, question mark, imperative form; undo tense/time/place shifts.
now→then, today→that day, tomorrow→next day; here→there; I→he/she; say vs tell; present reporting verb exception (no tense change).
